column1: # regenerated: 2026-08-27 (#3005 — partial: draw-split + entities only)
# WHY THIS MOVED, before the numbers (the #3005 CAUSE-NOT-BASELINE box).
# The 2026-08-16 sweep flagged this cell past the x1.1 contract on BOTH
# bench_draws_batches and bench_draws_gpu_calls while bench_draws_cmds stayed
# inside it. Re-measured at cc666a48 on 2026-08-27
# (`--game fo3 --cell MegatonPlayerHouse --bench-frames 240`, xvfb):
#   metric               2026-06-14 baseline   2026-08-27   x1.1 gate
#   bench_draws_cmds     1839                  1581         PASS (fell)
#   bench_draws_batches    96                   164         FAIL (+71%)
#   bench_draws_gpu_calls   9                     9         PASS (recovered)
# The gpu_calls half of the finding is GONE; only the batch split remains.
# The cause is not a batching bug and is already documented in code: see
# `draw_sort_key`'s alpha-over branch in `byroredux/src/render/mod.rs`
# (RT-1 / #2215). True alpha-over draws sort depth-primary, so draws that
# would otherwise share `group_state` stop being contiguous whenever a
# different-state alpha-over draw sits at an intervening depth — each
# interruption opens a new `DrawBatch`. That ordering is the deliberate,
# required cost of the #1804/#2237 compositing fix (a farther decal/puddle
# drawing after a nearer glass pane and showing through as a rectangular
# patch); a state-primary sort can only be correct when the interleaved draws
# never overlap on screen, which this key cannot determine. That comment
# records the direct experiment: forcing state-primary order drops FNV
# `FreesideAtomicWrangler` from 25 to 8 GPU calls.
# Merge efficiency here fell 19.2 -> 9.6 cmds/batch. Refreshed rather than
# left red because a gate against 96 is now permanently failing and would
# mask any NEW batching regression — the same reasoning the FNV baseline
# records under #3288.
# entities_total 3311 -> 3493 (+5.5%) also exceeds its +/-2% tolerance and is
# refreshed with the same measurement.
# PARTIAL REFRESH — only the rows this run measured were updated:
# entities_total, bench_fps_*, bench_draws_*, skin_pool_*. The
# `byro-dbg`-sourced rows (tex_missing_unique_paths, mesh_cache_failed_count,
# light_count_directional) were NOT re-captured in this session and are
# carried forward from 2026-06-14 unchanged — do not read them as re-verified.
